Markets leaned lower, with 6 of 7 tracked indexes down; Nikkei 225 down 2.57% was the largest move. Benchmarks tracked: S&P 500, NASDAQ Composite, Euronext 100 Index, and Public Joint-Stock Company Moscow Exchange MICEX-RTS plus 3 more indexes. headlines.title: Russians pull billions from banks, fearing Kremlin will seize deposits for war
headlines.summary: Russians are withdrawing billions, causing liquidity problems for banks and undermining the Kremlin’s ability to issue bonds to finance the fight in Ukraine.

headlines.title: U.S. Navy destroyer lost power for 4 days in South China Sea
headlines.summary: The ship’s crew lost access last month to drinkable water, running toilets and air conditioning, as the fleet sees heavy use by the Trump administration.

headlines.title: Kushner, Netanyahu make little progress on advancing Gaza deal after meeting
headlines.summary: President Donald Trump’s son-in-law and envoy first held rare talks with Hamas’s new leader in Egypt over the weekend in his effort to advance the stalled 15-point plan.

headlines.title: Trump defends his move to cut back U.S.-South Korea military exercises
headlines.summary: A day after attributing the decision to a good relationship with North Korea, President Donald Trump also tied the move to South Korea’s refusal to help with the Strait of Hormuz.

headlines.title: Trump threatens to bomb Oman if it ‘gets in the way’
headlines.summary: The threat came in response to a question about negotiations between Iran and Oman regarding control of the Strait of Hormuz, according to a reporter.

headlines.title: US refineries taking in half of Venezuela’s oil output, official says
headlines.summary: US official says Venezuela is sending 500,000 of its 1.25 million barrels per day output to Gulf Coast refineries.

headlines.title: How Ebola became the deadliest outbreak in DR Congo’s history
headlines.summary: Conflict, delayed detection, and mistrust are complicating efforts to contain the virus in eastern DR Congo.

headlines.title: Quebec separatist says no independence referendum while Trump in office
headlines.summary: Leader of Canadian province's secessionist party says debate over independence stymied by turbulence in US politics.

headlines.title: Trump denies talks with Iran; Tehran claims US begging for negotiation
headlines.summary: Trump says no talks with Tehran scheduled; Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi claims US 'begging' for negotiations.

headlines.title: Democrats call for USS Lincoln probe, question US Navy’s readiness
headlines.summary: Lawmakers question whether conditions on the aircraft carrier indicate a 'pattern' of poor planning amid the Iran war.

headlines.title: Key results from Florida primaries, so far
headlines.summary: Voters in Florida are picking their party's candidates for governor, Senate and a number of U.S. House seats after redistricting.

headlines.title: Embattled Florida Republican Rep. Cory Mills loses his fight to keep his House seat
headlines.summary: Mills is the latest lawmaker in a recent string of congressional members facing scandals and allegations of domestic abuse while trying to run for elected office.

headlines.title: ABC and Disney sue FCC, alleging First Amendment violations
headlines.summary: The ABC network has sued the Federal Communications Commission, alleging that the Trump administration is violating its First Amendment rights by challenging ABC broadcast licenses and investigating the network's talk show The View .

headlines.title: 'Profits won.' The child safety trial against Meta kicks off in federal court
headlines.summary: Opening arguments are underway in a trial that pits four states against the company that owns Facebook and Instagram. They allege that Meta knew its products could hook kids — and lied about the danger.

headlines.title: S. Korea stresses US alliance amid confusion over Trump drill cut
headlines.summary: Lee's comments Tuesday come as many South Koreans remain baffled and concerned about U.S. President Donald Trump's abrupt order to "substantially reduce" military exercises with South Korea.

headlines.title: Sharing cultures, building connections
headlines.summary: In a traditional courtyard, sunlight streamed through carved wooden windows, falling onto a table covered with bamboo strips and colorful paper. The courtyard belongs to a workshop in Hongcun, a historic village at the foot of Huangshan Mountain in East China's Anhui province.

headlines.title: Gaza stalemate continues as Israel, Hamas hold firm
headlines.summary: JERUSALEM — US President Donald Trump's envoy Jared Kushner left Jerusalem on Monday without a breakthrough after two days of talks with Israeli and Hamas leaders over a stalled plan to end the conflict in Gaza, with both sides standing firm on key demands.

headlines.title: Germany demands Apple revise app consent prompts
headlines.summary: United States tech giant Apple is set to revise the policies that govern third-party developers' use of personal data for ad targeting on iPhones and iPads, Germany's competition watchdog said on Monday, concluding a multiyear probe.

headlines.title: Poll to decide Malaysia's national fruit
headlines.summary: KUALA LUMPUR — The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security of Malaysia is proposing that the Department of Statistics Malaysia conduct a nationwide survey to gather public views on the choice for national fruit.

headlines.title: Envoy: International effort needed to resolve issues in Libya
headlines.summary: A Chinese envoy to the United Nations said that the international community must work toward a comprehensive and fundamental solution to the issues facing Libya and its long-delayed elections.

headlines.title: Govt. to procure 405 key defence items from Indian industry
headlines.summary: Govt. announces procurement of 405 defence items from Indian industry, boosting domestic manufacturing and reducing import dependence.

headlines.title: Trump cites CEC Gyanesh Kumar to make case for U.S. voter ID law; Congress says ‘take him to America’
headlines.summary: Pawan Khera sarcastically responds to Trump's SAVE Act proposal, suggesting taking India's election chief and EVMs to America.

headlines.title: Census 2027 questionnaire seeks parents’ religion, place of birth up to village level
headlines.summary: Census 2027 questionnaire collects detailed demographic data, including parents' religion and birthplace, along with caste options.

headlines.title: Past controversies resurface as new BJP social media team’s X posts disappear
headlines.summary: BJP's new social media team faces scrutiny as controversial posts vanish following Deepak Mhaske's appointment amid ongoing protests.

headlines.title: Dabholkar murder: Bombay HC grants bail to convict Sachin Andure, suspends his life sentence
headlines.summary: Bombay High Court grants bail to Sachin Andure, convicted in rationalist Narendra Dabholkar's murder, suspending his life sentence.
